releases.notes:
- Lanterns can now be placed against more blocks.
  - It can be placed against any block that has a side positioned between 0 (aka full block) and 6 (aka fence) pixels from block's edge.
- Improved Stumps:
  - Stumps can now be placed directionally.
  - If you place a block in front of Stump's facing direction it will now take full block height.
- You can now connect fences directly with Leads.
  - No extra hidden mob required!
